summaryJa: MISREP（発信: 50ATKS）。任務: JSR（ATO 1.4a）、作戦: OP SPARTAN SHIELD、支援対象: NAVCENT。機（コールサイン: 1.4a）がOMAMから240015Z OCT23に離陸。オンステーションは240155Zから、オフステーションは241912Z。総飛行時間20時間43分。OMAMへ242058Z着陸、242108Zエンジン停止。任務中、0155–1837ZにIMINTを実施し（JSR記録）、AIRHANDLER経由で（記録上）0150Xから2019ZまでSIGINTを収集。FMVはDGS-2により解析された。0145Zにイラン空防から「国境から安全距離を保て」とのプロフェッショナルなガードコールを受信し、当機は「連合機が国際空域で通常任務中」と応答、通話はその後終了。UAPインシデントは初接触240241Zとして記録。観測ではUAPは固体、熱画像で「冷」と表示、観測者は無害と評価し、知的制御は無しとされる。その他多くのUAP情報やセンサー詳細は不明または黒塗り。
summaryEn: MISREP (originator: 50ATKS). Mission: JSR (ATO 1.4a) supporting OP SPARTAN SHIELD for NAVCENT. Aircraft callsign 1.4a departed OMAM at 240015Z OCT23. Time on station began 240155Z and off station at 241912Z. Total mission time 20:43. Landed OMAM at 242058Z and engine shutdown at 242108Z. During the mission IMINT was conducted from 0155–1837Z (per JSR entry) and SIGINT was collected via AIRHANDLER (records indicate collection from ~0150X to 2019Z). FMV was exploited by DGS-2. At 0145Z the aircraft received a professional guard call from Iranian Air Defense (“maintain safe distance from border”); the aircraft replied that it was a coalition aircraft conducting routine operations in international airspace and the calls ceased. A UAP incident is recorded with initial contact at 240241Z: the UAP was noted as a solid object, thermal signature showed cold, observer assessed it as benign, and it was reported not under intelligent control. Many UAP and sensor details are unknown or redacted.
